strawberry.title: Still life with strawberries in a crystal bowl.jpg
strawberry.author: W.carter
strawberry.description: Still life with freshly picked local strawberries in a crystal bowl on a striped tablecloth in Tuntorp, Brastad, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden. Photographed in natural evening light from a window. The idea was to borrow the light and composition style from old still-life paintings, preferably 17th-century Dutch paintings . Many of those paintings of food depicted it as if the meal was in progress. This was a technique they had to show that is was a painting of a fleeting moment, and that everything in life is transient.

sugar.author: Tobias Erbsland
sugar.description:
This photo shows granulated white sugar made from sugar beets with unusual large crystals. The manufacturer rejected the product because the crystals were larger than usual. Some of the shown granules are around two millimetres.
I made this photo with bright light direct through a thick layer of sugar crystals. Under these conditions, the crystals appear yellowish.
